name: Zillertal Residenz
beschreibung:
The Zillertal Residenz is located in Dornauberg near Ginzling, a district of Finkenberg in the rear Zillertal, at around 1,008 meters above sea level. The country house with a large garden offers two holiday apartments: the Zillertal Residenz with 70 m², divided into an open living area with kitchen, terrace, bedroom with dressing room and bathroom, as well as the LifeStyle Residenz on the ground floor with 165 m², open kitchen, three bedrooms, two bathrooms and space for up to six people.

The furnishings follow the style of KARE Design, with wooden and stone floors. Amenities include Wi-Fi, a parking space, terrace, garden furniture, ski storage room and bicycle storage room. The Demeter organic farm Lengauerhof is about 700 meters away, Mayrhofen and Finkenberg are reachable in less than ten minutes by car. Heating is provided by wood chips. The Mayrhofen tourism portal rates the property with four edelweiss, check-in from 4 PM, check-out by 9 AM.
